BTC_LOWVOL_TREND_BREAKOUT.timeframe: 1D, decision at daily close, entry next open

rules.entry: close > highest high of previous 20 days
rules.stop: 3.5 x ATR14, closing-basis; hard intraday stop at -10%
rules.volatility_gate: skip if stop distance > 10% of entry
rules.break_even: at +1R move stop to entry + costs (0.7%)
rules.position: Rs 1,00,000 notional, long only, no leverage, one position at a time

caveats: OOS sample (7 trades) below the 30-trade target
30% crypto tax + cess, no loss set-off

rules.exit: 15:25 price > previous day's high, or 10 days

caveats: P&L uses futures-equivalent cost 0.04%; delivery/ETF costs (~0.2%+) would consume most of the edge
negatively skewed payoff (avg loss ~1.7x avg win)
